pairs: For he has reinforced the bars of your gates.
He has blessed your sons within you.
He has stationed peace at your borders,
and he has satisfied you with the fat of the grain.
He sends forth his eloquence to the earth.
He sends his ice crystals like morsels.
ante faciem frigoris ejus quis sustinebit?
Who can stand firm before the face of his cold?
He will send forth his word,
He announces his word to Jacob,
his justices and his judgments to Israel.
He has not done so much for every nation,
et judicia sua non manifestavit eis.
and he has not made his judgments manifest to them.
